slides.title: Teacher CV: what *schools* look for
slides.sub: Swipe. Save this for your next application.

slides.title: Qualifications first
slides.body: Teaching qualification, subject degree, registration and safeguarding training, with the awarding body and year.

slides.title: Describe the class
slides.body: Age group, class size, specialisms such as special needs or English as an additional language, and the curriculum you taught.

slides.title: Show impact you can back up
slides.body: Progress of a group, a club you started, a project you led. No figure? Describe the change in plain words.

slides.title: A short summary
slides.body: Two or three sentences: who you teach, how many years, what you do best. Skip long statements of philosophy.

slides.title: Build your teaching CV
slides.sub: Upload the one you have or start fresh. Full guide: aicvstudio.app/cv-for/teachers
